name: XLR8
abilities: Enhanced speed (500+ mph; time appears to stop)
Vortex generation by running in circles
weaknesses: Magnets and charged pulses throw him off course
Slips on ice; sticks to adhesive surfaces (Sploot's goo)
Fast-reacting foes (Transylians, Tetramands, Vulpimancers) can counter him
summary: Ben's blue speedster: a visored raptor-like Kineceleran who moves so fast the world seems frozen and can run up walls and across water.
traits: Slide-down face visor is biological, not mechanical
Ben 10,000's XLR8 could circle the globe in seconds
Faster on the ground than Jetray
notableFeats: Beat Hex in a museum in his first real fight (Lucky Girl)
Chased down and defeated the storm entity S.A.M. (Monster Weather)
Cycled every combination to disarm SevenSeven's bomb on Ben 23 (Store 23)
Knocked over a Way Bad (The Frogs of War: Part 2)
Saved Dr. Holiday from Alpha (Heroes United)

appearances.designNotes: Black bodysuit with a white centre stripe, black cone helmet with visor, blue face with green eyes, black tail with five blue stripes, original Omnitrix on chest. Ben 10,000's XLR8 is taller with white stripes, longer sleeves and a scanner visor.
Same as the Original Series but slightly darker skin and more muscular, drawn in Generator Rex's style; Ultimatrix on chest.

image.label: HU
image.notes: Heroes United frame with XLR8 alone (previous frame included another character). No UA/HU render exists on the wiki. Verified 2026-08-17.

appearances.designNotes: Taller; the white on the shirt becomes green and covers the neck; four tail stripes; bigger foot-balls; darker visor. 11-year-old keeps a white shirt and has three tail stripes.

scoring.rationale: Supersonic runner who effectively stops time, runs on walls and water and whips up lifting vortexes; hits hard for his size but is a light-weight melee fighter. Magnets, ice and sticky surfaces neutralise him.

notes: UA record rests solely on the Heroes United crossover (a Generator Rex episode; wiki lists it under 'Generator Rex'); XLR8 was re-unlocked in Ben 10,000 Returns but never used in a UA episode proper - flag for QA if crossovers should be excluded.
Also used by Ken (Ken 10) and Gwen 10 (And Then There Was Ben) - not counted.
